label: 4K HDR streaming player, wired + wireless
description: 2022 Roku Ultra streaming player with 4K/HDR10+/Dolby Vision, Wi-Fi 5 and a 10/100 Ethernet port, plus USB 3.0 and a lost-remote finder. Mains powered, no PoE.
notes: Both wired (10/100 Ethernet only - not gigabit) and wireless (802.11ac dual-band). No PoE. Streams are the bulk of the traffic; the 100M port caps 4K bitrate headroom well below a gigabit link.
